notes.title: Developers' team rebranding: Welcome "Have a Dream"
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We’re excited to share some important news about our journey! Our development team is officially rebranding and changing our name to [b]Have a Dream[/b]. 🌙✨[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43914305/f1456d1122625dcfd579832cc6bebf3e657bd0a8.png"][/img]

If you love the moon like I do, or believe in the unlimited speed of snails, then this magical combination will give our studio a new cosmic name - Moon Snail.[/p][p]But if you’re a dreamer, with your dream always in your heart, and you’re surrounded by like‑minded people, then this choice will give our team the inspiring name - Have a Dream.

This new name better reflects our vision and creative direction moving forward. While our name is changing, our passion and dedication to bringing you unique and memorable gaming experiences remain the same.[/p][p]Nothing else is changing — you’ll still see the same team, the same updates, and the same commitment to the game you love.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of this adventure with us. We can’t wait to show you what’s next under our new name, [b]Have a Dream[/b].[/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates soon! 💫[/p][p]– The Have a Dream Team[/p]
